name: tokyo-metropolitan-government-building
description: Tokyo Metropolitan Government confirms No1 has48storeys, No2 is163m/34storeys and Assembly41m/7storeys. CTBUH gives No1 architectural height243.4m. The official plan documents the open civic court.
attribution: Original Low Poly Earth geometry; plan measurements © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), production vectors via Protomaps.

audit.estimates: All component plans and intermediate133/176/207m steps are OSM measurements. 39m floor datum uses mapped ele=39 and adjacent west terrain; elevated15–25m connectors preserve the road beneath. Stone ribs are a reduced exterior interpretation.
audit.ground_method: Fixed approach datum, bounded lower-only cuts inside authored structure, perimeter supports sampled at every authored toe and buried 0.5m. No roof-driven datum; final engine contact review required.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
